notes: EVAL-WEIGHTS stories defined across schema, logic, API/UI, integration, and testing.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for weight configuration
Added core logic for weighted scoring recalculation
Added API and frontend UI for adjusting weights
Added integration with provider and clinical trial scoring engines
Added unit and integration test coverage

EVAL-WEIGHTS-S1.title: Define Weight Configuration Schema and Persistence Contract
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S1.description: Define a schema for user-adjustable weights across quality measures, including defaults, bounds, normalization rules, and persistence model for storing user preferences.
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S1.evidence: GAP: No weighting schema or persistence model exists; must define contract for measure weights and storage

EVAL-WEIGHTS-S2.title: Implement Weighted Scoring Recalculation Logic
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S2.description: Extend scoring engines to accept dynamic weight inputs and recompute composite scores deterministically for providers and clinical trials.
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S2.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/facades/evaluate_care_facade.py and clinical_trials_service.py show existing deterministic scoring without weighting

EVAL-WEIGHTS-S3.title: Expose Weight Adjustment API and Frontend Controls
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S3.description: Create backend API endpoints to set and retrieve user weights and build frontend controls (e.g., sliders or inputs) to allow users to adjust measure importance and trigger score recalculation.
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S3.evidence: GAP: No API or UI exists for weight adjustment in current frontend (ChatWindow.tsx) or backend

EVAL-WEIGHTS-S4.title: Integrate Weight Preferences into Evaluate Care Flow
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S4.description: Integrate persisted or session-based weight preferences into Evaluate Care facade so all score responses reflect user-defined weighting consistently.
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S4.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/facades/evaluate_care_facade.py orchestrates scoring but lacks preference injection

EVAL-WEIGHTS-S5.title: Add Unit and Integration Tests for Weighting System
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S5.description: Create tests validating schema constraints, scoring recalculation accuracy, API behavior, and end-to-end integration of weight-adjusted scores.
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S5.evidence: GAP: No existing tests cover weighting logic; current test suite lacks weighting scenarios
